title: useSetState Hook
description:
Implement a `useSetState` hook that stores unique values and returns `{ set, add, remove, has, toggle, clear }`. The `set` value is a JavaScript `Set`. `toggle(item)` adds if absent, removes if present.

**Example:**
```tsx
const { set, add, remove, has, toggle, clear } = useSetState(['a', 'b']);
```
ai_context: Common mistake: mutating the existing Set with set.add(item) and passing it to setState — React won't see a new reference, so it won't re-render. Always create a new Set.
